u0: Initial state: the matching door key has not yet been carried on any move, and the door is closed. The active objective is to locate and pick up the key whose color matches the locked door.
u1: The agent has carried the matching key on one qualifying move but has not yet satisfied the two-move key-holding requirement, and the door is not open. Next, keep or reacquire the matching key and hold it on another distinct move; if holding it when toggling, opening the door can satisfy the second key-holding move and advance directly. If the key is dropped before the door is open, it is lost and must be recovered.
u2: The matching key has been held on at least two distinct moves, so the key-holding requirement is satisfied, but the door is still closed. Next, use the matching key to toggle the door open; if the key is no longer carried after meeting the requirement, recover it first so the door can be opened before entering the target room.
u3: The door has been opened and the key-holding requirement is already satisfied, but the mission-designated box has not been picked up. Next, reach the box in the second room; if still carrying the key, drop it to free the hand, and reopen the door if it has been toggled shut. The episode is not terminal until the correct box is picked up.
uF: Final terminal state: the mission-designated box has been picked up, completing the task after the key-holding and door-opening milestones. The episode ends successfully, and no further objective remains.
